name: Local API Reference
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select a tag from the menu to reduce the endpoint list while the view stays open.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Local API Reference is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for reading your API files with it.

related.blurb: Compare two local JSON files and save added, removed, and changed values in a note.

related.blurb: Convert selected YAML, JSON, or TOML data with a preview and checks for data loss.
